page.notes: Greek and Hebrew words are transcribed from a small, blurred scan and several are uncertain; the Greek forms (e.g. ῥοφθωci, σιβαρὸν, Οσραίος) and Hebrew forms (e.g. עוז, קשה, עזי) should be checked against the original.
